title: Ask's redlines do at least as well on unseen requests as before the calm redline change
goal: After Ask started choosing measurements in code, its scores on unseen measuring requests fell even though the settings screenshot request got better. Find what kind of measuring request now does worse and fix it, without tuning to any one request.
notes: Measured, not guessed: held-out run 20261021-010309-ask-held-out (before, commit 4514d304) redline group 35.4; after the calm redline (c9200d34) 20261021-050656-ask-held-out redline 19.5; after the follow-up fixes (aa4e3ce3: an empty find_measurements answer says to fall back to find_elements, Ask lays only the ids that answer the request, a redline never drops below three marks) 20261021-055152-ask-held-out redline 19.6. Totals 20.1 / 19.2 / 19.5. Only one baseline run exists, so a lucky baseline is possible: rerun the before commit's held-out once before chasing. A runner may not open Scripts/ask-eval/held-out/ or .ask-eval/held-out-runs/; the user can look at .ask-eval/held-out-runs/20261021-055152-ask-held-out/contact-sheet.png. Ideas not yet checked: requests that name a dimension the plan never measures (a card's width, the title's size), pictures LayoutRead reads poorly (dark app windows, photos), and the prompt sending every measuring request to find_measurements.
acceptance: The held-out redline group is back to at least 35 (Scripts/ask-eval.sh run --engine ask --set held-out, then report), with the climb settings-measurements case no lower than 47
The cause is named in the task log in general terms (a kind of request or a kind of picture), never as a particular held-out request

digest 2026-11-07: two more readings, 30.3 (20261107-013327-ask-held-out) and 33.9 (20261107-130822-ask-held-out). Last six: 33.6, 44.1, 44.1, 33.8, 30.3, 33.9, so four of six are under the 35 bar, and three cases swing it by about 10. No time-outs in the group. Whoever claims this: one run cannot prove the bar either way; judge on several readings.

Cause, in general terms: the layout reader under find_measurements was built on one light settings screenshot and misreads other kinds of screen. A window edge line joined to a full width divider swallowed every word of a dark panel; a gradient button with a glow read as a photo and was never measured; a photo in a card read as a box with a thick border. And requests that name one part (a card) or ask about one button got a crop that lost the card's edge, or nothing that answered, so the model fell back to guessing boxes. Three new climb cases show it: Ask scored 9.3, 17.7 and 21.7 on them at HEAD. Fixed in f5eab0d42; the four redline climb cases went 25.1 -> 43.6.

left rough: a glowing button swallows small words inside its glow (the version line under the download button) so they are not obstacles and a readout can sit on them; named-card requests still get oddly placed calipers from the model's own add_measurement calls (card case 27.9). Neither earned its own task: both show up in the redline cases this task added, so the next pass on Ask's redlines climbs on them. Readout placement folded into a-redline-of-a-2x-screenshot-reads-in-points-wit.

Measured on f5eab0d42 (new nine-look judge, rubric 4a03a8fc): held-out run 20261110-021212-ask-held-out redline 36.4 (bar 35), total 56 over 53; climb settings-measurements 48 (run 20261110-051609-ask; bar 47). The settings picture is byte for byte the same as on 2026-11-02 and read 51.6, 49.1, 43.7, 48 on four judgings, so that case's spread is the judge alone. One held-out reading: the old judge swung this 3-case group by about 10; the new one is steadier but a later run could still land under 35. No held-out case was opened.

Cause: the layout reader under find_measurements misread screens unlike the light settings pane (a window edge joined to a divider swallowed a dark panel's words, a glowing gradient button read as a photo, a photo in a card read as a bordered box), and a request naming one card or one button got a crop with no card edge, or nothing that answered. Fixed in f5eab0d42 (LayoutRead, RedlinePlan, region as focus, padding into a box, prompt line), with tests and three new climb redline cases. Held-out redline 36.4 (bar 35, run 20261110-021212-ask-held-out); climb settings-measurements 48 (bar 47); full test suite green. Audit queue/audits/2026-11-09-ask-redlines-on-unseen-screens.json.
